blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Razon Group is acquiring a 30-percent stake in a company that holds a service contract to harness petroleum resources in the West Philippine Sea. On Tuesday, Apex Mining Co. Inc. informed the local bourse that Prime Oil and Gas Inc. offered to acquire a 30 percent participating interest in Service Contract 72 held by its subsidiary, Monte Oro Resources and Energy Inc. (MOREI). READ: Notify DOE of West Philippine Sea oil and gas exploration plans, firms told Additionally, MOREI and Prime Oil and Gas are both part of the Razon Group.
